author: herbert-50
name: Fuji-like chart styles (F24/F49)
description: Twenty Fuji-like styles by herbert-50, created with darktable-chart from color target shots  Two sets, built from a 24-patch (F24) and a 49-patch (F49) chart, each contain a _BASE style that sets up the scene-referred workflow (exposure, input color profile, filmic rgb, tone curve and color look up table) plus nine film simulation looks to apply on top: Provia, Velvia, Astia, Classic Chrome, Eterna, Acros, Pro Neg Std, Pro Neg Hi and Sepia. The look styles also enable a watermark module that references the bundled right-red-text.svg; place it in darktable's watermarks folder or disable that module after applying.
